mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ${col}_num IS NULL OR ${col}_den IS NULL OR ${col}_den = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(${col}_num / ${col}_den * 100, 2), 'FM999990.00') || '%' END
mapper.select: SELECT stat_month AS month, AS emrUsageRate, AS standardDiagnosisRate, AS onTimeRate, AS stopRate, AS chemoRecordRate, AS chemoAdverseRate, AS chemoInfusionRate, AS criticalValueRate, AS bloodDrawErrorRate, AS surgeryComplicationRate, AS adverseEventRate FROM TR_QC_DTL WHERE stat_month BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} ORDER BY stat_month

SELECT stat_month AS statMonth, emr_usage_rate_num AS emrUsageRateNum, emr_usage_rate_den AS emrUsageRateDen, standard_diagnosis_rate_num AS standardDiagnosisRateNum, standard_diagnosis_rate_den AS standardDiagnosisRateDen, on_time_rate_num AS onTimeRateNum, on_time_rate_den AS onTimeRateDen, stop_rate_num AS stopRateNum, stop_rate_den AS stopRateDen, chemo_record_rate_num AS chemoRecordRateNum, chemo_record_rate_den AS chemoRecordRateDen, chemo_adverse_rate_num AS chemoAdverseRateNum, chemo_adverse_rate_den AS chemoAdverseRateDen, chemo_infusion_rate_num AS chemoInfusionRateNum, chemo_infusion_rate_den AS chemoInfusionRateDen, critical_value_rate_num AS criticalValueRateNum, critical_value_rate_den AS criticalValueRateDen, blood_draw_error_rate_num AS bloodDrawErrorRateNum, blood_draw_error_rate_den AS bloodDrawErrorRateDen, surgery_complication_rate_num AS surgeryComplicationRateNum, surgery_complication_rate_den AS surgeryComplicationRateDen, adverse_event_rate_num AS adverseEventRateNum, adverse_event_rate_den AS adverseEventRateDen, source_type AS sourceType, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, ext1 AS ext1, ext2 AS ext2, ext3 AS ext3 FROM TR_QC_DTL WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TR_QC_DTL t USING (SELECT #{statMonth} AS stat_month FROM DUAL) s ON (t.stat_month = s.stat_month) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET emr_usage_rate_num = NVL(#{emrUsageRateNum}, emr_usage_rate_num), emr_usage_rate_den = NVL(#{emrUsageRateDen}, emr_usage_rate_den), standard_diagnosis_rate_num = NVL(#{standardDiagnosisRateNum}, standard_diagnosis_rate_num), standard_diagnosis_rate_den = NVL(#{standardDiagnosisRateDen}, standard_diagnosis_rate_den), on_time_rate_num = NVL(#{onTimeRateNum}, on_time_rate_num), on_time_rate_den = NVL(#{onTimeRateDen}, on_time_rate_den), stop_rate_num = NVL(#{stopRateNum}, stop_rate_num), stop_rate_den = NVL(#{stopRateDen}, stop_rate_den), chemo_record_rate_num = NVL(#{chemoRecordRateNum}, chemo_record_rate_num), chemo_record_rate_den = NVL(#{chemoRecordRateDen}, chemo_record_rate_den), source_type = '人工登记', update_time = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( stat_month, emr_usage_rate_num, emr_usage_rate_den, standard_diagnosis_rate_num, standard_diagnosis_rate_den, on_time_rate_num, on_time_rate_den, stop_rate_num, stop_rate_den, chemo_record_rate_num, chemo_record_rate_den, source_type, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{statMonth}, #{emrUsageRateNum}, #{emrUsageRateDen}, #{standardDiagnosisRateNum}, #{standardDiagnosisRateDen}, #{onTimeRateNum}, #{onTimeRateDen}, #{stopRateNum}, #{stopRateDen}, #{chemoRecordRateNum}, #{chemoRecordRateDen}, '人工登记', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
